scope: Six early original recordings and their four corresponding first transparent cutouts. This is a bounded audit, not a claim that every possible source has been inspected.
method: Inspected original frames every half second and at endpoints. Decoded original cutout alpha with libvpx-vp9 and viewed composites on dark and warm backgrounds. No source pixels changed.
result: No clean native body interval of at least three seconds found in these sources. Bright bands exist in the original RGB, not solely in added runtime effects. No candidates admitted.

sources.finding: Persistent cyan tracing on forearms, dress, calves and boots; additional foot mist around 1.5-2.5 seconds.
Bowl lift and lowering; luminous bands remain across forearms and calves.
Turn and smile; blue bloom obscures the upper torso around 1.5-2 seconds.
Upward listening gesture; cyan bands remain across arms, dress and boots.
Gold wisp above the bowl around 1-2 seconds; cyan body tracing persists.
Gold glyph above the bowl around 0.5-2.5 seconds; cyan body tracing persists.

originalCutouts: parlor-maidens-v1 medium idle, alternate, reaction and whisper: 432x768 extractions retain bright edging and dark contaminated smoke.
currentLimitation: The live brazier body remains clean still artwork plus isolated bowl smoke. Good native body animation is still unresolved.
